description: Phase 1 (engine defaults): process a begins a transaction and updates V of all 64 rows of T; process b tries UPDATE statements on row 64 and on row 1 of table U, an INSERT of row 400 and a count of T, errors recorded; a rolls back. Phase 2: process a sets DBEngine.SetOption(dbMaxLocksPerFile, 8) in its own process, begins and runs the same bulk update (its error and RecordsAffected are recorded), then process b repeats its attempts; a rolls back and reads SUM(V). Asks what lock footprint a many-row transaction leaves for another process, with and without a low lock-count limit.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-3-4-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
